summary: ReNew Energy Global plc filed a Form 6-K on May 18, 2026, reporting its unaudited financial results for Q4 and FY ended March 31, 2026. The earnings release includes operating highlights such as portfolio capacity growth to ~20 GW, total revenue of INR 150,635 million for FY26, and net profit of INR 10,385 million. No transactional or special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review—is described. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
